children: Appian’s revenue and net income rose year over year in the third quarter, with total revenue increasing 25.5% as subscriptions and professional services both grew. Subscription gains reflected expanded customer deployments, renewal price increases and additional sales to existing customers; higher legal and personnel costs partly offset operating gains.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue rose 20.0% year over year to $136.4M.
: $37.1M of subscription revenue growth came from expanded deployments, renewal price increases and additional subscriptions.
: Net ARR expansion was 120% as of September 30, 2026, compared with 112% a year earlier.
: Total gross margin was 72.9%; subscriptions gross margin increased to 86.1% from 85.3%, while professional services gross margin declined to 20.5% from 27.1%.
